top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Fall as Oil Stokes Inflation Fears: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks fell, tracking losses on Wall Street, as surging oil prices stoked inflation concerns and as Treasury yields rose. Oil extended gains over $101 per barrel.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Global Money Trickles Back to Indonesia as Markets Recover
top_signals.summary: Global investors are tiptoeing back into Indonesian markets after the turmoil witnessed earlier this year, drawn by a striking rebound in local assets as policymakers stepped in to restore stability.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Inside India newsletter: India’s green push aims to boost energy security but exposes China dependency
top_signals.summary: India's ambition to create a self-reliant energy ecosystem by expanding its renewable energy footprint is facing a China problem.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Weak Southeast Asia Bond Auctions Offer Buying Chance, Funds Say
top_signals.summary: Sluggish demand at Southeast Asian bond auctions is creating entry points for fund managers drawn to the region’s economic resilience.
